scope: finite authored synthetic claim/experiment portfolio; CPU-only local WSLc; no live interface, GUI, model, GPU, or external service
distinct_factor: graph-aware shared-prerequisite experiment leverage versus cheapest-first, raw node-degree, and #6003 robust decision-reversal selectors

runtime.distro: Ubuntu on WSL2; not a WSL 3 distro

h_t_d_c_u.H: With two top decisions sharing a necessary premise, graph-aware selection chooses the test whose possible outcomes alter eligibility of more top decisions than cheapest-first, raw node-degree, and the prior-robust comparator. Disjoint, null, invalid, correlated, HOLD/STOP, or incomplete-coverage inputs must not invent shared decision effects.
h_t_d_c_u.T: Enumerate six frozen tests across PASS/FAIL/HOLD/STOP in the primary, disjoint, and null portfolios (72 before/after rows), with an incomplete-coverage selector gate and a fixed budget plus mandatory sentinel. Run one candidate and one separately implemented raw-only auditor in different WSLc containers. The auditor independently reconstructs the tables and runs eight effective result-corruption controls.
h_t_d_c_u.D: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if all independent tables and frozen gates agree: primary selectors cheapest=E-cheapest-inert, raw-degree=E-degree-decoy, robust-reversal=E-verify-unique, graph-aware=E-shared-prerequisite; disjoint graph-aware=E-verify-unique with at most one changed claim; null and incomplete coverage=UNRANKABLE; sentinel retained; HOLD/STOP neutral; invalid/correlated evidence not inflated; all eight effective corruptions rejected. Otherwise retain the first FAIL/HOLD/STOP.
h_t_d_c_u.C: The original #6003 decision-reversal card may already capture all useful consequences; a direct checklist may be simpler; if no eligible experiment changes the downstream decision, abstention is correct.
h_t_d_c_u.U: All graph nodes, edge-validity labels, source IDs, outcome weights, and top-claim rules are authored. No empirical utility/prior, assurance truth, safety, productivity, or runtime claim follows.

stop_rules: Any source, fixture, image, branch, path, ownership, or freeze mismatch stops before candidate invocation.
Run each formal command once; preserve the first output and do not retry a candidate/auditor failure under this allocation.
A candidate failure gates the auditor only if its preregistered input/output contract is absent; record the exact gate and stop.
HOLD and STOP outcomes never falsify or support a scientific premise.
Never infer cgroup/memory/swap enforcement from the requested --memory value.
execution_authority: The human user in this thread explicitly directs continued experiments in the current WSLc containers. This allocation uses its own paths and named CPU-only containers; it grants no release or reuse of another thread's allocation.
